name: IT Consultant
seoTitle: Business Insurance Cost for IT Consultants
seoDescription: Calculate estimated business insurance costs for it consultant businesses including general liability and professional E&O coverage.

industryContext.contextNote: IT consultants manage client systems and data remotely, making technology errors and data breaches the dominant risk rather than physical hazard.

riskFactors.title: System Downtime & Data Loss
riskFactors.description: A configuration error or failed migration can cause client system downtime or data loss, leading to significant financial-loss claims.

riskFactors.title: Cybersecurity Breach Liability
riskFactors.description: Consultants with access to client networks can be held partly responsible if that access is exploited in a breach.

riskFactors.title: Project Scope & Delivery Disputes
riskFactors.description: IT projects that run over budget or fail to meet technical specifications are a common source of contract disputes.

faqs.question: Why do IT consultants need Cyber Liability / Tech E&O coverage?
faqs.answer: This combined coverage protects against claims that a technical error caused data loss or a security breach, which General Liability specifically excludes.

faqs.question: What is the average cost of business insurance for an IT consultant?
faqs.answer: An IT consultant in the $0-50k revenue tier pays an estimated $280 per year for baseline General Liability coverage.

faqs.question: Does an IT consultant need General Liability if all work is remote?
faqs.answer: Many clients still require proof of General Liability in contracts even for remote work, and it covers any on-site visits for installation or troubleshooting.

faqs.question: Is Tech E&O different from standard Errors & Omissions?
faqs.answer: Tech E&O is tailored to technology services, combining professional liability for advice or code errors with cyber coverage for data breaches, offering broader protection than generic E&O alone.

blogContent.whyThisRiskFactor: IT consultants carry a 1.15 actuarial risk factor, reflecting elevated exposure to data-related claims despite minimal physical hazard.
blogContent.howCalculated: Premiums scale with revenue tier, team size, and Cyber Liability / Tech E&O endorsements covering data breach and system-error claims.
blogContent.comparisonNote: IT consulting premiums are moderately higher than general business consulting, reflecting the added cyber-risk exposure of managing client technology systems.
